content.text:
## Summary

**Defects found**

The page had one interactive widget — the custom "Sort" dropdown — that was entirely inaccessible from the keyboard:

1. `.dd-toggle` was a plain `<div>` with only a `click` handler: not focusable, no role/state, so keyboard users couldn't even reach it.
2. `.dd-option` items were plain `<div>`s with only `click` handlers: unreachable and unactivatable by keyboard, and had no selected/option semantics for assistive tech.
3. The decorative caret glyph (`v`) would be announced by screen readers as literal text.
4. No visible focus styling existed for the (previously non-focusable) dropdown parts.

**Fixes**

- Changed the toggle from a `<div>` to a real `<button type="button">`, keeping its `id`, `data-track`, and visual styling (added `font/color: inherit`, `margin: 0`, `text-align: left` resets so the native button renders identically to the old div). This restores native keyboard focusability and Enter/Space activation for free.
- Added `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls` to the toggle so its state and relationship to the list are exposed.
- Gave the list `role="listbox"` with an `aria-label`, and each option `role="option"` + `aria-selected`, updated on selection.
- Added roving keyboard support inside the listbox: ArrowUp/Down moves focus between options, Home/End jump to first/last, Enter/Space selects, Escape closes and returns focus to the toggle, Tab closes the list and lets focus continue naturally.
- Keyboard selection triggers `option.click()` rather than calling the selection logic directly, so it goes through the exact same code path (and the same real `click` event) as a mouse click — keeping `window.__activated` instrumentation accurate for both input methods.
- Marked the decorative caret `aria-hidden="true"` so it isn't announced as "v".
- Added explicit `:focus`/`:focus-visible` outline styles for the toggle and options, since these are custom-styled controls that need a visible focus indicator matching the design.

**Preserved / left alone**

- All `data-track` attributes and element `id`s stay on the same conceptual elements.
- The instrumentation `<script>` block is untouched.
- Visible text, layout, and visual design are unchanged (all edits are structural/ARIA or focus-only CSS that has no effect on box size or appearance).
- Result links (`<a data-track="result-N">`) were already natively keyboard-operable and needed no changes.
- No outside-click-to-close behavior was added since it wasn't part of the original mouse behavior — only keyboard parity for existing interactions was added (Escape/Tab close, matching what a mouse user achieves by clicking elsewhere or selecting an option).

1. `.dd-toggle` was a plain `<div>` with only a `click` handler: not focusable, no role/state, so keyboard users couldn't even reach it.
2. `.dd-option` items were plain `<div>`s with only `click` handlers: unreachable and unactivatable by keyboard, and had no selected/option semantics for assistive tech.
3. The decorative caret glyph (`v`) would be announced by screen readers as literal text.
4. No visible focus styling existed for the (previously non-focusable) dropdown parts.

**Fixes**

- Changed the toggle from a `<div>` to a real `<button type="button">`, keeping its `id`, `data-track`, and visual styling (added `font/color: inherit`, `margin: 0`, `text-align: left` resets so the native button renders identically to the old div). - Added `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls` to the toggle so its state and relationship to the list are exposed.
- Gave the list `role="listbox"` with an `aria-label`, and each option `role="option"` + `aria-selected`, updated on selection.
- Added roving keyboard support inside the listbox: ArrowUp/Down moves focus between options, Home/End jump to first/last, Enter/Space selects, Escape closes and returns focus to the toggle, Tab closes the list and lets focus continue naturally.
- Keyboard selection triggers `option.click()` rather than calling the selection logic directly, so it goes through the exact same code path (and the same real `click` event) as a mouse click — keeping `window.__activated` instrumentation accurate for both input methods.
- Marked the decorative caret `aria-hidden="true"` so it isn't announced as "v".
- Added explicit `:focus`/`:focus-visible` outline styles for the toggle and options, since these are custom-styled controls that need a visible focus indicator matching the design.

**Preserved / left alone**

- All `data-track` attributes and element `id`s stay on the same conceptual elements.
- The instrumentation `<script>` block is untouched.
- Visible text, layout, and visual design are unchanged (all edits are structural/ARIA or focus-only CSS that has no effect on box size or appearance).
- Result links (`<a data-track="result-N">`) were already natively keyboard-operable and needed no changes.
- No outside-click-to-close behavior was added since it wasn't part of the original mouse behavior — only keyboard parity for existing interactions was added (Escape/Tab close, matching what a mouse user achieves by clicking elsewhere or selecting an option).
